how: checks/web_wa2_readout.py, main's own code: B1953's law Y(g tau, w) = c phi U_L Y(tau, w g) U_R^dagger, fitted at all 24 points for T and S, read out for the down and up sectors, both readings, at two base points (residual 1.7e-15 or better). |U_L(T)| exchanges the first and third blocks and |U_L(S)| the first two; the projective orders of T, S and ST are 4, 2 and 3; the group they generate up to phases has 24 elements; U_L(T) is a real signed permutation up to one phase; U_L equals U_R up to a phase. So the blocks move by a group of order 24 with T of order 4, which is S4, and its permutation part is S3; for line 116's three levels: 2 is the permutation part (the moduli of U_L generate the symmetric group on the three blocks, T and S acting as transpositions), 4 is T's projective order on the blocks, both read out here, and 8 is the order of the T-eigenvalues of the Higgs-direction triplet, computed in B1952's part D (verification/wa2_on_main.py); that they are coprime to 5 is arithmetic.
